summary: The filing is a Form 6-K submitted by Pampa Energy Inc., a foreign issuer, containing its quarterly financial results for the three months ended March 31, 2026, compared to the prior-year period. It includes standard operating segment reporting for Oil and Gas, Generation, Petrochemicals, and Holding activities, along with forward-looking statements and management signatures. There is no mention of any merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, spin-off, or other special situation. The filing is a routine periodic report, not an event-driven disclosure.
